readable_name.description: Human-readable SDK name matching the SDK Doctor UI (e.g. 'Python', 'Node.js', 'Web', 'iOS').

latest_version.description: Most recent published version of this SDK.

needs_updating.description: True if this SDK needs attention (is_outdated OR is_old).

is_outdated.description: True if the primary in-use version is flagged as outdated.

is_old.description: True if the primary in-use version is flagged as old by age alone.

severity.description:
UI severity badge — 'none' when healthy, 'warning' when outdated, 'danger' when the majority of team SDKs are outdated.

* `none` - none
* `warning` - warning
* `danger` - danger

reason.description: Per-SDK programmatic summary (used for ranking/filtering). For user-facing copy, prefer releases[].status_reason (badge tooltip) and banners (top-level alert text) — those match the UI exactly.

banners.description: Top-level alert sentences matching the SDK Doctor UI's 'Time for an update!' banner — one per outdated version with significant traffic. Quote verbatim when surfacing the headline to users.

releases.description: Per-version assessment for all versions seen in the last 7 days.

outdated_traffic_alerts.description: Outdated versions that handle a significant share of traffic (above the threshold). Not populated for mobile SDKs.
